The '''Crimson Phoenix''' was a decoration awarded by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to individuals who exhibited exceptional military service during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Reb-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Crimson Phoenix appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> With the release of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 3|Chapter 3: Smugglers and Scoundrels]] on [[September 27]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref> the Crimson Phoenix Medal of the Rebel Alliance was included as a wearable medal sold by Rebel [[Recruitment officer/Legends|recruiters]] to players of the Rebel Alliance [[W:c:swg:Faction|faction]] who attained at least the [[W:c:swg:Faction rank|rank]] of sergeant major.<ref name="SWG" />
